eyebrow: Q: SIGTERM vs SIGKILL — why it matters for deploys
code:
SIGTERM (15): "please shut down" -- catchable,
  process can finish in-flight work first
SIGKILL (9): immediate, no cleanup, not catchable

K8s sends SIGTERM -> waits
terminationGracePeriodSeconds -> then SIGKILL

If checkout ignores SIGTERM, a rolling deploy
can drop in-flight order submissions
